title: Mallorca · Visión general
description: Todas las fuentes en una vista: indicadores, mapa, gráficas y la tabla de series temporales. Filtra por una o varias fuentes con el selector.

list.name: source
list.label: Fuentes
list.description: Una o varias fuentes: filtra indicadores, mapa, gráficas y tabla.
list.query: SELECT label AS __text, source AS __value FROM gold.dim_sources ORDER BY label
list.definition: SELECT label AS __text, source AS __value FROM gold.dim_sources ORDER BY label

list.name: metric
list.label: Métrica
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM gold.agg_daily_metrics WHERE source IN ($source) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM gold.agg_daily_metrics WHERE source IN ($source) ORDER BY 1

list.name: entity
list.label: Entidad
list.description: Localidad, estación o parada que tiene la métrica elegida.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT entity FROM gold.agg_daily_metrics WHERE source IN ($source) AND metric = '$metric' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT entity FROM gold.agg_daily_metrics WHERE source IN ($source) AND metric = '$metric' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fuentes OK
panels.description: Fuentes seleccionadas cuya última ejecución terminó bien.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success'), ' / ', count(*)) AS "Fuentes" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (source) source, status FROM ops.ingestion_runs WHERE source IN ($source) AND status <> 'running' ORDER BY source, started_at DESC) last_runs

panels.title: Observaciones
panels.description: Valores no ausentes de las fuentes seleccionadas en el rango de tiempo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Observaciones" FROM gold.fct_observations WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Sospechosos
panels.description: Porcentaje de valores marcados como sospechosos por las reglas de calidad o por la propia fuente.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(100.0 * avg(is_suspect::int), 0) AS "% sospechosos" FROM gold.fct_observations WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Fallos
panels.description: Ejecuciones de las fuentes seleccionadas que fallaron en el rango (p. ej. una API caída). La siguiente ejecución recupera los días perdidos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Fallidas" FROM ops.ingestion_runs WHERE status = 'failed' AND source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
SELECT extract(epoch FROM max(finished_at)) * 1000 AS "Última ingesta" FROM ops.ingestion_runs WHERE status = 'success' AND source IN ($source)

panels.title: Sismos
panels.description: Sismos localizados por el IGN en el rango (Mallorca y el mar que la rodea) y su magnitud máxima.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Sismos", max(magnitude) AS "Magnitud máx." FROM gold.fct_earthquakes WHERE 'ign' IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Mapa de fuentes
panels.description: Puntos: calidad del aire del modelo Open-Meteo (color según el índice europeo). Termómetros: estaciones reales de SOCIB con su última hora. Ondas: sismos del IGN en el rango (tamaño y color según la magnitud). Mancha de calor: autobuses programados por parada de EMT Palma el último día del rango. REData no aparece: es el sistema eléctrico balear entero, no un punto.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.entity) a.entity AS localidad, l.lat, l.lon, a.european_aqi_model AS european_aqi, a.eaqi_label AS calidad, a.ts AS hora FROM gold.air_quality_hourly a JOIN gold.dim_locations l USING (source, entity) WHERE 'open_meteo' IN ($source) AND a.european_aqi_model IS NOT NULL AND a.ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY a.entity, a.ts DESC

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity, max(ts) AS ts FROM gold.fct_observations WHERE source = 'socib' AND ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY entity) SELECT o.entity AS estacion, l.lat, l.lon, max(o.value) FILTER (WHERE o.metric = 'temperature_2m') AS "temperatura (°C)", max(o.value) FILTER (WHERE o.metric = 'relative_humidity_2m') AS "humedad (%)", max(o.value) FILTER (WHERE o.metric = 'wind_speed_10m') AS "viento (km/h)", latest.ts AS hora FROM gold.fct_observations o JOIN latest ON latest.entity = o.entity AND latest.ts = o.ts JOIN gold.dim_locations l ON l.source = o.source AND l.entity = o.entity WHERE o.source = 'socib' AND 'socib' IN ($source) GROUP BY o.entity, l.lat, l.lon, latest.ts ORDER BY o.entity

SELECT event_id AS sismo, lat, lon, magnitude AS magnitud, depth_km AS "profundidad (km)", distance_to_palma_km AS "distancia a Palma (km)", ts AS hora FROM gold.fct_earthquakes WHERE 'ign' IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY magnitude

SELECT l.lat, l.lon, a.avg_value AS buses FROM gold.agg_daily_metrics a JOIN gold.dim_locations l USING (source, entity) WHERE 'emt_palma' IN ($source) AND a.source = 'emt_palma' AND a.metric = 'scheduled_departures' AND a.local_date = (SELECT max(local_date) FROM gold.agg_daily_metrics WHERE source = 'emt_palma' AND local_date <= $__timeTo()::date)

panels.title: $metric · media por fuente
panels.description: Media horaria de la métrica en cada fuente seleccionada. Con temperatura o viento compara las estaciones reales de SOCIB con el modelo de Open-Meteo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', o.ts) AS time, s.label AS metric, avg(o.value) AS value FROM gold.fct_observations o JOIN gold.dim_sources s USING (source) WHERE o.metric = '$metric' AND o.source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(o.ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $metric · por entidad
panels.description: Cada localidad, estación o parada elegida en el selector Entidad.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, entity AS metric, value FROM gold.fct_observations WHERE metric = '$metric' AND source IN ($source) AND entity IN ($entity) AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Electricidad de Baleares: demanda e intensidad de CO₂
panels.description: REData: demanda horaria (MWh, eje izquierdo) e intensidad diaria de emisiones (tCO₂/MWh, eje derecho). El mix por tecnología está en la tabla de series.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, value AS "Demanda (MWh)" FROM gold.fct_observations WHERE 'redata' IN ($source) AND source = 'redata' AND metric = 'electricity_demand' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, value AS "Intensidad CO₂ (tCO₂/MWh)" FROM gold.fct_observations WHERE 'redata' IN ($source) AND source = 'redata' AND metric = 'co2_intensity' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Calidad diaria por fuente
panels.description: Porcentaje de valores válidos y no sospechosos de cada fuente por día.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.local_date::timestamptz AS time, s.label AS metric, 100.0 * sum(a.n_valid - a.n_suspect) / nullif(sum(a.n_samples), 0) AS value FROM gold.agg_daily_metrics a JOIN gold.dim_sources s USING (source) WHERE a.source IN ($source) AND a.local_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Series temporales
panels.description: Una fila por serie (fuente, entidad y métrica) en el rango: días con datos, completitud, valores sospechosos y estadísticos diarios. Los sismos, que son eventos, están en el mapa y en el indicador.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.label AS "Fuente", a.entity AS "Entidad", a.metric AS "Métrica", max(a.unit) AS "Unidad", count(*) AS "Días", 100 * avg(a.completeness) AS "Completitud", 100.0 * sum(a.n_suspect) / nullif(sum(a.n_valid), 0) AS "Sospechosos", min(a.min_value) AS "Mínimo", avg(a.avg_value) AS "Media", max(a.max_value) AS "Máximo", (array_agg(a.avg_value ORDER BY a.local_date DESC))[1] AS "Último día (media)", max(a.local_date)::text AS "Último día" FROM gold.agg_daily_metrics a JOIN gold.dim_sources s USING (source) WHERE a.source IN ($source) AND a.local_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY s.label, a.entity, a.metric ORDER BY 1, 3, 2

panels.title: Operación: ejecuciones y reglas de calidad

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at AS "Inicio", s.label AS "Fuente", r.status AS "Estado", r.window_start::text AS "Desde", r.window_end::text AS "Hasta", r.payloads AS "Payloads", r.rows_silver AS "Filas silver", r.rows_upserted AS "Insertadas/actualizadas", round(extract(epoch FROM r.finished_at - r.started_at)::numeric, 1) AS "Duración (s)", r.error AS "Error" FROM ops.ingestion_runs r LEFT JOIN gold.dim_sources s USING (source) WHERE r.source IN ($source) ORDER BY r.started_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s.label AS "Fuente", q.rule AS "Regla", q.target AS "Objetivo", q.checked AS "Revisados", q.failed AS "Fallos", q.passed AS "OK", q.failed_ratio AS "% fallos", q.checked_at AS "Fecha" FROM gold.data_quality_summary q LEFT JOIN gold.dim_sources s USING (source) WHERE q.source IN ($source) ORDER BY q.passed, q.failed DESC, s.label, q.rule
